page.overview:
What is Argentina?

Argentina, officially the Argentine Republic, is a country in the southern half of South America that borders Chile to the west, Bolivia and Paraguay to the north, Brazil to the northeast, and Uruguay to the east. Its capital and largest city is Bueno Aires. It maintains the second-largest economy in South America. Its environment includes part of the Andes mountain range and the plains of the Pampas. This is where the tango dance and famous writer originate from, but also the earliest (Eoraptor, Herrerasaurus, Pisanosaurus) and biggest dinosaurs (Argentinosaurus, Dreadnoughtus, Patagotitan). Argentina hosts numerous geological sites and dinosaurs, with notable ones being Giganotosaurus, Carnotaurus, Amargasaurus, Austroraptor, Saltasaurus, and .

Richard Levine mentions that he thinks that the dinosaur that killed his guide Diego was a Carnotaurus, which originated from the Gorro Frigo formation in Argentina.

Argentina is one of the countries where the visitors from your park come from.

The Glacier Park from the game is revealed to be located inside Argentina, more specifically Patagonia. Argentina also appears in a promotional quiz for the game, on which country Giganotosaurus was discovered (with Argentina being the correct answer).
